title: Writing Practice — Training hours for volunteer guides — Take a position
description: Academic Task 1 data report and Task 2 essay. Take a position. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The table shows average hours of training completed by volunteers at three venues over four consecutive years.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Volunteers who give regular tours should receive some reimbursement for their time.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
